div.div: شَعْشَعَانٌ : see شَعْشَاعٌ, in two places. With ة, applied to a she-camel, meaning Tall: (S, * O:) or large in body: (TA:) pl. شَعْشَعَانَاتٌ. (S, O. [In the TA, شَعْشَعَانَاتٌ is said to be mistranscribed in the S شَعْشَعَانَان: but it is not so in either of my copies.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
